data.title: Editorial
data.tagline: Use publication-style typography, imagery, and pacing to tell a story
data.description: Editorial web design borrows from magazines through expressive headlines, considered image crops, captions, columns, and varied pacing. It works when the content deserves sustained reading. The layout should adapt without turning mobile into a squeezed print spread.

avoid: Use dramatic layouts around thin content
Make body text secondary to decoration
Copy a print spread without responsive behavior
Mix typefaces with no assigned editorial roles

data.agentPrompt: Editorial magazine page, large serif headline with sans-serif body, responsive columns, drop cap, masthead and issue details, warm paper background, large photography with precise captions
